what_it_is.prose: DRDO is India's premier defence R&D organisation under the Department of Defence R&D, Ministry of Defence. With over 50 laboratories across India, DRDO develops missiles (Agni, Prithvi, BrahMos co-development, Akash, Astra), UAVs (Lakshya, Nishant, Tapas-BH, SWiFT, Ghatak UCAV), radars (BEL-produced), electronic warfare (Himraj, Maareech), and counter-UAS systems (RF jammers, directed energy). DRDO's counter-UAS portfolio includes RF/EO systems transferred to BEL for series production and deployed along India's western border.

faq.question: What is DRDO's role in counter-UAS?
faq.answer: DRDO develops RF detection, jamming, and EO/IR tracking subsystems for counter-UAS systems; production is transferred to BEL. Systems are deployed along India's western border.

faq.question: How many labs does DRDO have?
faq.answer: DRDO operates over 50 laboratories across India, including dedicated labs for UAVs (ADE), EW (DLRL), airborne systems (CABS), missiles (RCI), and aerial delivery (ADRDE).
